attacks.claim: The go.mod `replace go.uber.org/zap => ../zap` points the build at an unpinned local directory outside the repo. CI builds the distributed binary from a clean checkout, so either the build breaks because ../zap is absent, or whatever code happens to sit at ../zap on the runner gets compiled into the binary that on-call runs on laptops. The pinned pseudo-version is also silently overridden.
